scripts.sidecar: cd ml && uv run pyinstaller --onefile --noconfirm --name kura-worker-$(rustc --print host-tuple) --distpath ../src-tauri/binaries --workpath ../build/pyinstaller --specpath ../build entry.py
scripts.icon: mkdir -p build && cd ml && uv run python -c "from PIL import Image; Image.new('RGBA',(1024,1024),(28,28,26,255)).save('../build/icon.png')" && cd .. && tauri icon build/icon.png
scripts.sidecar-onedir: cd ml && uv run pyinstaller --onedir --noconfirm --name kura-worker --distpath ../src-tauri/resources --workpath ../build/pyinstaller --specpath ../build entry.py
